info.background_text:
A girl inheriting her first Admired person.
She dislikes violence and combat but became a combatant to protect people in place of someone she admired. Fundamentally upright and diligent, she is a student as well as a combatant, and she studies whenever she gets a chance, demonstrating her responsible nature.
